Owner-thread sampling of a managed DEBUG grant. Passive physical-JVM MinecraftServer tick hook counter and explicit managed sampling are separate. Shared native helper identity is required. No world mutation or user input. Runtime read and typed Debug authorize separately.

presentation.hudOcclusionPolicy: USER HUD text only with no Screen/Overlay; Toast text only fully shown
limitations: Typed Vanilla HUD: title/subtitle/actionbar, item hotbar, boss bars, sidebar, effect icons and player-list text; other HUD and third-party render overrides remain unsupported
Player list exposes native display names/header/footer only, not profile identity, exact latency, skins or objective scores/hearts; USER requires the native list to be visible
Effect icon opacity comes from the last completed native draw at the same player/Screen/GUI size, no older than 250 ms; no amplifier/duration or third-party draw guarantee
Toast text: System/Tutorial/Advancement/Recipe from native render callbacks; other types expose identity only; no queued text in USER

USER Toast nodes use completed native draw geometry bound to toast/world/camera/Screen/Overlay/GUI size for 250 ms; partial entry/exit exposes clipped bounds and phase without text, while fully shown text retains its native phase. This is not framebuffer or third-party occlusion proof
Item name, durability/cooldown and contextual bars use bounded completed native HUD draws; no raw item, XP, jump or waypoint state.

Vital icons are the ordered native glyph composition, including container/blinking/foreground layers; no raw health, food, air, saturation or mount statistics. The completed sample is world/camera/Screen/size bound, expires after 250 ms and fails closed beyond 256 glyphs; third-party draw replacement and final pixel occlusion are not guaranteed.
